final: SELECT d.district_id, d.A3 AS region, COUNT(*) AS client_count, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER (PARTITION BY d.A3) AS share_of_region, CAST(COUNT(*) AS REAL) / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () AS share_of_overall FROM disp AS p JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = p.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.district_id, d.A3 ORDER BY share_of_overall DESC LIMIT 10
